0022600230.text: The Hornets, now 3-7 and 10th in the East, are on a six-game losing streak and have gone 1-3 on the road, while the Suns are 3-5, 12th in the West, and riding a two-game winning streak after going 3-2 at home. Charlotte will be without Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps), and Phoenix will be without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their two games in 2025-26, with Charlotte winning the last meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026.
